# Trade Arts

> Trade Arts is a design-to-fabrication studio in Mullumbimby, Northern NSW, near the Gold Coast. It designs and builds props, sets, exhibitions and public art for production designers, museums, councils and agencies across Australia.

Led by Bryce Noakes, Trade Arts works with production designers, art directors, artists, museums and brand teams. The Mullumbimby workshop brings 3D modelling, printing, CNC fabrication and scenic finishing into one collaborative process, from the first model to the final finish.

- Workshop: Unit 1/24 Towers Drive, Mullumbimby NSW 2482, Australia
- Email: info@tradearts.work
- Phone: 0431 802 800
- Website: https://www.tradearts.work/

## Services

- [Services overview](https://www.tradearts.work/services/): 3D scanning, 3D printing, CNC fabrication, scenic finishing and design for film, exhibitions, public art and cultural projects.
- [3D Scanning](https://www.tradearts.work/services/3d-scanning/): scanning for reverse engineering, digital archiving and object replication.
- [Advanced 3D Printing](https://www.tradearts.work/services/advanced-3d-printing/): large-format FDM and high-resolution resin printing for props, prototypes, replicas and exhibition elements.
- [CNC & Precision Fabrication](https://www.tradearts.work/services/cnc-precision-fabrication/): CNC routing and precision metal fabrication for set construction, props and exhibition builds.
- [Design & 3D Modelling](https://www.tradearts.work/services/cad-design-drafting-services-trade-arts/): CAD design, 3D modelling and digital sculpting, from concept sketches to production-ready build files.
- [Exhibition & Public Art](https://www.tradearts.work/services/exhibition-public-art/): fabrication for exhibitions, public artworks and cultural infrastructure, from concept to installation.
- [Scenic Finishes & Paintwork](https://www.tradearts.work/services/scenic-finishes-paintwork/): scenic finishing, weathering, patinas and paintwork for film props, exhibition pieces and immersive builds.

## Work

- [Film / TV](https://www.tradearts.work/works/): props, set decoration and builds for film and television.
- [Commercial](https://www.tradearts.work/commercial/): hero props and objects for music videos, photoshoots, retail and campaign work.
- [Exhibitions](https://www.tradearts.work/exhibitions/): museum displays, replicas, immersive brand experiences and touring exhibitions.
- [Public Art](https://www.tradearts.work/public-art/): turning public-art concepts into practical fabrication and installation strategies.

## Selected case studies

- [Runner](https://www.tradearts.work/work/runner-1/): hospital rooms and corridors, a sculpted fountain and a stunt bar for the feature film Runner.
- [Spiders: Fear & Fascination](https://www.tradearts.work/exhibition/australian-museum-spiders/): touring exhibition designed and built for The Australian Museum.
- [Reserve Bank Museum, New Zealand](https://www.tradearts.work/exhibition/reserve-bank-museum-nz/): a permanent banking museum with secure showcases, interactives and on-site installation.
- [Pterodactyl](https://www.tradearts.work/exhibition/pterodactyl/): a full-scale exhibition creature from digital sculpt through large-format 3D printing and scenic paintwork.
- [Bunya Cone Replica](https://www.tradearts.work/exhibition/bunya-cone-replica/): a bunya cone replicated with 3D scanning, large-format 3D printing and scenic paint finishing.
- [Superfun Console](https://www.tradearts.work/commercial-project/superfun-console/): the physical Superfun Console made for The Avalanches.
- [LEGO Brick Brigade](https://www.tradearts.work/commercial-project/lego-brick-brigade/): oversized components for Rockstar Agency's LEGO World Play Day activation.
- [reVITALise Public Art Concept](https://www.tradearts.work/public-art/revitalise-coffs-harbour/): an unbuilt Stage 1 public-art concept developed with artist Belem Lett for the City of Coffs Harbour.
